name: AppUi::ListToolbar
description: The top of a list page box: the search and the page actions in the box header, the selection bar with bulk actions on the left of the controls row and the pager on its right. It shows the selection of the list it is given and gives the search the width first in small spaces.

position.description: top (default) draws the header and the controls row; bottom draws only the controls row below the list

selection.description: The Selection (utils/state/selection.js) also given to AppUi::DataTable; with it the toolbar draws the selection bar and the selection block is not used

rows.description: The rows of the current page; the select-all and the counts work on them

onSelectionChange.description: The select-all or clear changed the selection

search.description: The search in the box header: put EzSearch here and pass it @narrow={{narrow}}

actions.description: Page actions after the search, such as the create button (with AccessControl); show icon-only buttons when narrow

bulkActions.description: In the selection bar, while rows are selected: the bulk buttons

selection.description: The left of the controls row when @selection is not given: the select-all checkbox and the bulk action buttons

pager.description: The right of the controls row: AppUi::Pager

variants.name: with selection
variants.description: @selection and @rows: the selection bar with counts and bulk actions

variants.name: list page
variants.description: Search, create button, own selection controls and pager

variants.name: controls only
variants.description: No header; the selection and the pager

variants.name: bottom
variants.description: position bottom: the selection and the pager below the list
